cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Back my stall at the fete. Sign here above 'joint entrant.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the penalty clause below it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fill in the stall details. We'll go through the penalty as partners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put your name first, then. I'll sign beneath it and handle the rest of the form.
